review.reviewedBy: Codex exact API source, all current soul branches and state assertions
review.rationale: 真实魂印2063/f339f486，四个技能槽及第五排除、回初双条件独立执行、同一来源刷新与双方不同来源保留、随机不补抽及回血顺序已实测；双方均指当前在场双方，无队伍依赖。
review.singleBehavior: 1/3槽200盾与敌随机三弱，2/4槽200魂印回血与自身随机三强；整次技能命中零红仍一次、MISS/无效/控制/药剂不触发、第五排除；回初正负段数绝对和*15按两个独立条件授双方盾罩，同源刷新不触发消失且异源独立。

success.name: 4876全部15招有序编译、64种子基础及完整真实2063原生用招，真实因子只解锁同一原生魂印/第五而非捏造强化版
success.assertion: test('4876全部15招有序编译、64种子基础及完整真实2063原生用招，真实因子只解锁同一原生魂印/第五而非捏造强化版',()=>{assert.equal(source.souls.length,1);assert.equal(source.souls[0].hash,'f339f486');const raw=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4876/source.json').records.find(x=>x.resourceKey==='factor/2400556').data;assert.equal(raw.hash,'eeeb5619');assert.equal(raw.soulmark.id,2063);assert.equal(raw.skill.id,38287);for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4876 base '+m.id);}});

success.name: 4876真实2063按当前1/3格命中授200盾并敌随机三弱，2/4格回复200并自身随机三强，六槽无放回且每项来源真实
success.assertion: test('4876真实2063按当前1/3格命中授200盾并敌随机三弱，2/4格回复200并自身随机三强，六槽无放回且每项来源真实',()=>{const covered=new Set();for(let slot=1;slot<=4;slot++)for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=slotMake(slot,{hp:1000,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s,20117,null);const f=s.fighters[0],event=f.soulState.slotHits2063[0];assert.equal(event.slot,slot);assert.equal(event.move,key(20117));assert.equal(event.chosen.length,3);assert.equal(new Set(event.chosen).size,3);for(const k of event.chosen)covered.add(k);if(slot%2){assert.equal(f.hp,1000);assert.equal(require('../dist/shield-rules.js').sourceValue(f,'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),200);assert.equal(keys.reduce((n,k)=>n-s.fighters[1].stages[k],0),3);}else{assert.equal(f.hp,1200);assert.equal(keys.reduce((n,k)=>n+f.stages[k],0),4);}}assert.deepEqual(covered,new Set(keys));});

success.name: 4876真实2063已命中零红仍授盾与弱化，MISS/无效/控制/药剂不触发，第五第5格不触发任何格位分支
success.assertion: test('4876真实2063已命中零红仍授盾与弱化，MISS/无效/控制/药剂不触发，第五第5格不触发任何格位分支',()=>{for(const mode of['zero','miss','invalid','control','potion','fifth']){const s=make({move:mode==='fifth'?38287:10001,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal((s.fighters[0].soulState.slotHits2063??[]).length,mode==='zero'?1:0);if(mode==='zero'){assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(require('../dist/shield-rules.js').sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),200);}}});

success.name: 4876真实2063能力免弱或自身禁强仍抽三项不补抽，等级上下限保持；魂印回血不受技能禁疗且满HP不溢出
success.assertion: test('4876真实2063能力免弱或自身禁强仍抽三项不补抽，等级上下限保持；魂印回血不受技能禁疗且满HP不溢出',()=>{for(const mode of['weakimmune','floor','ban','cap','healban','full']){const slot=['weakimmune','floor'].includes(mode)?1:2,s=slotMake(slot,{hp:mode==='full'?8999:1000});if(mode==='weakimmune')timer(s,1,'免弱');if(mode==='floor')for(const k of keys)s.fighters[1].stages[k]=-6;if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'禁强化');if(mode==='cap')for(const k of keys)s.fighters[0].stages[k]=6;if(mode==='healban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,20117,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.slotHits2063[0].chosen.length,3);if(mode==='weakimmune')for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],0);if(mode==='floor')for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],-6);if(mode==='ban')for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],0);if(mode==='cap')for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],6);if(mode==='healban')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1200);if(mode==='full')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}});

success.name: 4876真实2063回初双方正负等级绝对值合计乘15，大于/小于/相等分别授盾/罩/两者含零边界
success.assertion: test('4876真实2063回初双方正负等级绝对值合计乘15，大于/小于/相等分别授盾/罩/两者含零边界',()=>{for(const [pos,neg,shield,barrier]of[[4,1,60,0],[1,4,0,60],[3,3,45,45],[0,0,0,0]]){const s=slotMake(2);s.fighters[0].stages.atk=pos;s.fighters[1].stages.def=-neg;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');for(const f of[c.a,c.t]){assert.equal(S.sourceValue(f,'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),shield);assert.equal(S.barrierSourceValue(f,'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),barrier);}checked=true;}},()=>turn(s,20117,null));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.balanceRound2063[0].positive,pos);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.balanceRound2063[0].negative,neg);}});

success.name: 4876真实2063同一魂印同源盾回初与命中重授刷新，异源盾罩保留且刷新不触发消失；双悠悠两名来源分别保留
success.assertion: test('4876真实2063同一魂印同源盾回初与命中重授刷新，异源盾罩保留且刷新不触发消失；双悠悠两名来源分别保留',()=>{const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js'),s=slotMake(1);S.refresh(s.fighters[0],500,'soul2063:f339f486:owner0');S.refresh(s.fighters[0],70,'other');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[0],80,'other');s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;let before;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){before=S.sourceValue(c.a,'soul2063:f339f486:owner0');assert.equal(before,30);}},()=>turn(s,20117,null));assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),200);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'other'),70);assert.equal(S.barrierSourceValue(s.fighters[0],'other'),80);const snap=structuredClone(source),ids=[20117,20004,10001,10129,38287],both=E.createBattle({wikiSnapshots:[snap,snap],wikiLoadouts:[ids,ids],criticals:false});both.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;both.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;both.auditMoveId=20117;turn(both,20117,null);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(both.fighters[0],'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),200);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(both.fighters[0],'soul2063:f339f486:owner1'),30);});

success.assertion: test('4876真实2063已命中零红仍授盾与弱化，MISS/无效/控制/药剂不触发，第五第5格不触发任何格位分支',()=>{for(const mode of['zero','miss','invalid','control','potion','fifth']){const s=make({move:mode==='fifth'?38287:10001,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal((s.fighters[0].soulState.slotHits2063??[]).length,mode==='zero'?1:0);if(mode==='zero'){assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(require('../dist/shield-rules.js').sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),200);}}});

success.assertion: test('4876/4/5真实攻防弱化和自身攻击强化，33消强保护失败保留，3净弱受不可解除保护；31连击2或3段各扣一次PP',()=>{for(const [move,side,values]of[[20117,0,{atk:1}],[20004,1,{def:-1}],[20002,1,{atk:-1}]]){const s=make({move});turn(s,move,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(values))assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],v);}for(const protect of[false,true]){const s=make(row(33));s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(protect)timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,protect?2:0);const a=make(row(3));a.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;if(protect)timer(a,0,'弱化不可解除反转');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,protect?-2:0);}const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({...row(31),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10258)],source.moves.find(x=>x.id===10258).pp-1);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([2,3]));});

success.assertion: test('4876真实2063已命中零红仍授盾与弱化，MISS/无效/控制/药剂不触发，第五第5格不触发任何格位分支',()=>{for(const mode of['zero','miss','invalid','control','potion','fifth']){const s=make({move:mode==='fifth'?38287:10001,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal((s.fighters[0].soulState.slotHits2063??[]).length,mode==='zero'?1:0);if(mode==='zero'){assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(require('../dist/shield-rules.js').sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'soul2063:f339f486:owner0'),200);}}});

success.name: 4876/4/5真实攻防弱化和自身攻击强化，33消强保护失败保留，3净弱受不可解除保护；31连击2或3段各扣一次PP
success.assertion: test('4876/4/5真实攻防弱化和自身攻击强化，33消强保护失败保留，3净弱受不可解除保护；31连击2或3段各扣一次PP',()=>{for(const [move,side,values]of[[20117,0,{atk:1}],[20004,1,{def:-1}],[20002,1,{atk:-1}]]){const s=make({move});turn(s,move,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(values))assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],v);}for(const protect of[false,true]){const s=make(row(33));s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(protect)timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,protect?2:0);const a=make(row(3));a.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;if(protect)timer(a,0,'弱化不可解除反转');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,protect?-2:0);}const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({...row(31),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10258)],source.moves.find(x=>x.id===10258).pp-1);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([2,3]));});

success.name: 4876/16真实爱心5%睡眠有成功失败且免疫不补抽；173先手80%害怕有成功失败，后手不附
success.assertion: test('4876/16真实爱心5%睡眠有成功失败且免疫不补抽；173先手80%害怕有成功失败，后手不附',()=>{let sleepSeed;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=128;seed++){const s=make({...row(16),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']);if(s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'])sleepSeed=seed;}assert.equal(seen.size,2);const immune=make({...row(16),seed:Math.imul(sleepSeed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});immune.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'],undefined);const fear=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const s=make({...row(173),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);fear.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}assert.equal(fear.size,2);const late=make({...row(173),aStats:{spe:50}});turn(late);assert.equal(late.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

success.name: 4876/2079敌盾时优先级1且红伤穿盾不消耗盾，1616真实暗影克制才获得1.5本系加成，1048敌已有异常才额外红伤50%
success.assertion: test('4876/2079敌盾时优先级1且红伤穿盾不消耗盾，1616真实暗影克制才获得1.5本系加成，1048敌已有异常才额外红伤50%',()=>{for(const shield of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2079));if(shield)require('../dist/shield-rules.js').refresh(s.fighters[1],2000,'enemy');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,shield?1:0);if(shield)assert.equal(require('../dist/shield-rules.js').sourceValue(s.fighters[1],'enemy'),2000);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}for(const type of['超能','火']){const a=make(row(1616)),b=make({...row(1616),index:-1});a.fighters[1].type=b.fighters[1].type=type;const probed=effectProbe(()=>turn(a));turn(b);const effective=E.typeEffectiveness('暗影',type,a.typeChart)>1;assert.equal(probed.stab,effective?1.5:undefined);if(effective)assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.4);else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}for(const ailment of[false,true]){const a=make(row(1048)),b=make({...row(1048),index:-1});if(ailment)for(const s of[a,b])s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(a);turn(b);if(ailment){assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*1.5));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*1.5));}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}});

success.assertion: test('4876/1683两回合提升保护实际阻消强及吸强，第三回合到期；1232反自身弱化成功才反馈，禁强和不可反转不反馈',()=>{const s=make({...row(1683),loadout:[38285,10001,29277,29278,38287]});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){let removed;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){removed=c.clearBoost(c.t);c.steal(c.a,c.t,'技能');}},()=>turn(s,r===1?38285:10001));assert.equal(removed,r===3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,r<=2?2:0);}for(const mode of['normal','ban','locked','enemyimmune']){const a=make(row(1232));a.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;a.fighters[0].stages.spe=-1;if(mode==='ban')timer(a,0,'禁强化');if(mode==='locked')timer(a,0,'弱化不可解除反转');if(mode==='enemyimmune')timer(a,1,'免弱');turn(a,a.auditMoveId,null);const success=!['ban','locked'].includes(mode);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,success?2:-2);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.atk,success&&mode!=='enemyimmune'?-2:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4876/191四回合免疫反弹优先次数免异；707真实低体回复翻倍、满体溢出和技能禁疗，1886清回合响应下回仅红额外减少100%',()=>{const a=make(row(191));a.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);for(const [hp,ban,want]of[[1000,false,7000],[4500,false,7500],[8999,false,9000],[1000,true,1000]]){const s=make({...row(707),hp});if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,want);}const s=make({...row(1886),loadout:[29277,10001,29278,38286,38287]});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clear(c.t);},()=>turn(s));turn(s,10001,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);turn(s,10001,10127);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);});

success.name: 4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费
success.assertion: test('4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费',()=>{const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1828));S.refresh(s.fighters[1],2000,'shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'barrier');if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');let remaining;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='attackDamageTaken'&&c.a.side===1)remaining=(c.a.suitState.shield??0)+(c.a.suitState.barrier??0);},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(remaining<2500&&remaining>0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:Math.floor(remaining*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);}const a=make(row(928));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);timer(a,1,'攻击必中');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a,29277));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});

success.assertion: test('4876/707四回合使用技能才回复，药剂不触发而不受技能禁疗，1886下回红减100%不阻固定百分比真实伤害',()=>{const s=make({...row(707),loadout:[29277,10001,29278,38286,38287],hp:1000});for(let r=1;r<=5;r++){s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s,r===1?29277:r===2?null:10001);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,r===2?1250:r<=4?7000:1000);}const p=make({...row(1886),loadout:[29277,10001,29278,38286,38287]});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clear(c.t);},()=>turn(p));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const before=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'1886非红独立通道',type);assert.equal(before-c.t.hp,100);}},()=>turn(p,10001,10127));assert.equal(sum(p,'attack',1),0);});

success.name: 4876/16真实爱心5%睡眠有成功失败且免疫不补抽；173先手80%害怕有成功失败，后手不附
success.assertion: test('4876/16真实爱心5%睡眠有成功失败且免疫不补抽；173先手80%害怕有成功失败，后手不附',()=>{let sleepSeed;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=128;seed++){const s=make({...row(16),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']);if(s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'])sleepSeed=seed;}assert.equal(seen.size,2);const immune=make({...row(16),seed:Math.imul(sleepSeed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});immune.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'],undefined);const fear=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const s=make({...row(173),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);fear.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}assert.equal(fear.size,2);const late=make({...row(173),aStats:{spe:50}});turn(late);assert.equal(late.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费',()=>{const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1828));S.refresh(s.fighters[1],2000,'shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'barrier');if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');let remaining;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='attackDamageTaken'&&c.a.side===1)remaining=(c.a.suitState.shield??0)+(c.a.suitState.barrier??0);},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(remaining<2500&&remaining>0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:Math.floor(remaining*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);}const a=make(row(928));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);timer(a,1,'攻击必中');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a,29277));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});

interaction.assertion: test('4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费',()=>{const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1828));S.refresh(s.fighters[1],2000,'shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'barrier');if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');let remaining;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='attackDamageTaken'&&c.a.side===1)remaining=(c.a.suitState.shield??0)+(c.a.suitState.barrier??0);},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(remaining<2500&&remaining>0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:Math.floor(remaining*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);}const a=make(row(928));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);timer(a,1,'攻击必中');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a,29277));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});
